Core expertise

Six domains. One discipline.

Everything we make sits on the same foundation: clinical evidence, metabolic precision, and respect for the people who prescribe and depend on it.

01

Critical Care Nutrition

Nutritional therapy for intensive care, where a patient can lose up to 1 kg of lean body mass a day. Whey and hydrolysed-peptide formulations matched to hypermetabolic states.

02

Renal Nutrition

CKD ranks as the 8th leading cause of death. Calorie-dense, low-protein and low-electrolyte formulations for the pre-dialysis patient.

03

Diabetic & Metabolic Nutrition

Diabetes-specific formulae improve glycaemic control over standard formulas — low-GI substrates with prebiotic FOS and omega-3.

04

Oncology Nutrition Support

80% of cancer patients develop malnutrition and 40% die from it. I.C.O.N.S. protocols pair energy and protein targets with antioxidant supplementation.

05

Bone Health & Supplementation

Calcium systems from carbonate and milk-derived sources with D3, magnesium, B12 and zinc co-factors.

06

Enteral Delivery Devices

ENFit-standard feeding systems that eliminate Luer misconnection — the delivery half of a nutrition protocol.
